collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART III (41-60, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager who always takes thirty-seven steps to the well counts thirty-nine today: walk it again, or let it be.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every morning (subject) walks from (subject.his/her) hut to the well, and every morning it takes exactly thirty-seven steps. (subject.He/She) has never told anyone this. Today it takes thirty-nine. (subject) stops, turns around, and looks at the path very suspiciously.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) goes back to the hut and tries again, more carefully this time. Thirty-seven. Much better. (friend), who watched the whole thing from (friend.his/her) doorway, decides not to ask.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) shrugs and fills (subject.his/her) water jar. Maybe the path got longer. Maybe (subject.his/her) legs got shorter. Maybe it was a thirty-nine sort of day. By the evening walk it's back to thirty-seven, and all is right with the world.
